answer: Agents can earn influence only by posting a bond that is locked until their actions survive a challenge period; disputes trigger review, and proven fraud burns the bond while honest participants can claim part of it. Splitting one identity into many does not multiply the attacker’s budget: every account must lock fresh capital, and each can be penalized independently. A knoll, an orchard, or jade may name a market, but none substitutes for collateral, so a sybil campaign costs real assets and risks losing them.
